name: payment_flip

criteria.true: the payment went through: it was completed and not declined, failed or reversed
criteria.false: the payment did not go through: it was declined, failed, not processed or reversed/refunded

notes: minimal_pair: 200 pairs of near-identical notifications (one detail flips success to failure: a status word, an inserted 'not', a reversal) plus 200 unpaired successes from the same generator (the failure twin discarded), so failure is ~33%. Pair members are never adjacent in the stream. Predicted: mean pooling barely moves when one word flips, so hunch should struggle on the failure minority; understudent's max/attention pooling may catch the flipped token. Neither is expected to fully take over.
